product.name: NASA PGDA 69 · LOLA AVGVISIB_75S_120M_201608 / _EARTH / LPSR_75S_120M_201608
product.period: ≈18.6 years (one lunar nutation cycle), hourly time steps

criterion.sun: percentage of timesteps where each pixel was sunlit (by any fraction of the solar disc)
criterion.earth: percentage of timesteps where each pixel was sunlit (by any fraction of the Earth disc)

product.observer: at the DEM surface (no height above ground stated in the product labels)
product.citation: Mazarico, E., Neumann, G. A., Smith, D. E., Zuber, M. T., Torrence, M. H. (2011). Illumination conditions of the lunar polar regions using LOLA topography. Icarus 211, 1066-1081. doi:10.1016/j.icarus.2010.10.030
